title: Token response
description: A successful response from the token endpoint: a new or renewed Session (spec 4.2), a sign-in (4.4), an Account Token (4.8), or a Bearer token for an MCP server by Token Exchange (4.3). The Session is named by the key in the request's DPoP Proof, not by a field in the response. refresh_token, the Account Token, is present after sign-in and when the Company rotates it. scope is left out for a signed-out Session, and for a signed-in one when the Company granted exactly the scopes requested (RFC 6749 section 5.1). Unknown fields are allowed.
